subject: Trading
title: Trend Following in Forex
description: A micro-lesson that makes Trend Following in Forex usable.

hook.text: Currencies trend for months or years—driven by interest rate cycles that unfold slowly and predictably.

buildup.text: Trend followers use moving averages and momentum indicators to identify and ride sustained currency moves.

discovery.text: A widening rate differential between two countries can push a pair in one direction for years.

twist.text: But trends end—often violently when central banks reverse policy. Late trend followers get caught in the reversal.

climax.text: Forex trends are driven by policy cycles. Understanding the cycle gives you the macro roadmap.

punchline.text: Follow the rate cycle, and the trend follows you.

quiz.question: What fundamentally drives long-term forex trends?
options: Interest rate cycles and central bank policy shifts
